{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Fix revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter to only completed orders
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
df_completed_clean = df_completed[df_completed['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Compute mean revenue for completed, non-QA orders
mean_revenue_completed_clean = df_completed_clean['revenue'].mean()

# Print result
mean_revenue_completed_clean"}
